status: prospective protocol; no CSV values parsed and no benchmark fitted

source.name: Appliances Energy Prediction
source.future_ingestion_rule: Require the locked archive hash, exact declared columns/order and row count, and unique increasing source-naive timestamps at exactly600-second increments. Header/timestamp metadata may be checked across the record for integrity only. Before fitting, parse and check finite numeric values only in development segments. After the full six-task fit seal, parse and validate the test numeric fields before test prediction/loss. No full-dataframe parse before that seal. No interpolation, row removal, reordering, or alternative dataset fallback. A failed gate stops the stage; a late test-integrity failure invalidates evaluation without adaptive replacement.

forecast.target_units: Wh per source ten-minute energy record
forecast.quantity: Direct point forecast of the energy reading h records after the latest completed observed record; not cumulative h-step energy
forecast.common_final_output_map_in_physical_unit: max(0, prediction_Wh), with no upper clip
forecast.target_standardization: Training-head-label mean and population standard deviation per horizon; zero standard deviation uses divisor1. The same target map is used by every fitted family at that horizon and inverted before physical-unit output clipping and loss evaluation. Validation/test targets never fit this map.
forecast.primary_loss: Mean squared error in Wh^2 on all common eligible test anchors
forecast.secondary_loss: Root mean squared error in Wh, derived from the same physical-unit MSE

features.calendar_definition: At the current origin timestamp, let f=(3600*hour+60*minute+second)/86400. Use sin(2*pi*f), cos(2*pi*f), sin(2*pi*(weekday+f)/7), cos(2*pi*(weekday+f)/7), with Monday=0. Preserve source-naive calendar stamps; do not infer a timezone or use a future measured covariate.
features.weather_exclusion_reason: The official metadata says hourly airport weather was interpolated. Its availability/interpolation direction at an online forecast origin is not established. Exclude the six channels rather than assuming causal interpolation.
features.source_date_column_role: Calendar construction only; no unrestricted numeric timestamp coordinate

partitions.index_convention: Zero-based raw row indices; all segment and anchor ranges are half-open
partitions.footprint_for_every_horizon: [origin-143, origin+36] inclusive lies wholly in its outer raw segment

reference_bank.selection_observes: Indices only; no feature magnitudes or target values
reference_bank.retained_priority_order: Original random permutation order; do not replace with chronological order before taking any reference-bank prefix
reference_bank.feature_use: Geometry and its input scalers may use reference features; forecast labels at the 512 reference anchors are not provided as training labels to the encoder or readouts
reference_bank.nystrom_use: The same reference bank is available to Nyström controls; when a smaller bank prefix is used, use the retained random priority order
reference_bank.input_scaler_use: Fit each candidate geometry input scaler on the designated reference-bank feature rows only; retain MinMax01 and standard-scaling comparison policy specified by the global protocol

partitions.head_training_rule: Use all outer-training eligible anchors except the 512 reference anchors, in chronological order. Every supervised model family uses the same head-training anchors and per-horizon labels.
partitions.within_outer_training_overlap: Reference and head anchor sets are disjoint, but their raw history/target footprints may overlap. This is permitted training-data reuse, not an independence claim.
partitions.outer_partition_overlap: None: full history/target footprints do not cross training, validation, or test boundaries.

baseline_information_controls.daily_seasonal: predict Appliances[origin+horizon-144]; this is one of the 144 allowed history coordinates for every declared horizon
baseline_information_controls.training_mean: Mean of head-training labels at that horizon

statistical_scope.real_world_unit: One building observed over one short chronological record
statistical_scope.test_temporal_stability_summary: Report paired loss means for the 26 consecutive complete 144-origin blocks starting at first test anchor15931, and retain the final24 origins separately. Primary MSE still uses all3768 origins.
statistical_scope.cross_task_claim_limit: This supplies a new domain and chronological holdout; it does not establish generalization across buildings or seasons. Statistical resampling, if added by the global frozen protocol, must state dependence/stationarity assumptions separately from arithmetic enclosures.
